Que Pode Potencializar Sua Candidatura

Porque o desafio de desenvolver as melhores soluções para impulsionar o negócio de milhares de empresas é também o que nos motiva para transformar nossas ideias em resultados, criando grandes experiências para as nossas pessoas e evoluindo o ecossistema tech.

Uma empresa GPTW que se orgulha das suas pessoas e que busca oferecer jornadas de crescimento, aprendizado e valorizando a diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos.

Porque é mais que uma vaga. É uma vaga na Senior.

Sobre o Desafio

Como Coordenador(a) de Geração de Demanda, você será responsável por liderar uma de nossas equipes de Desenvolvimento de Receita, focada em gerar leads qualificados para o time de vendas.

Suas responsabilidades incluem orientar e treinar a equipe BDR, colaborar estreitamente com vendas e produtos para alinhar estratégias, implementar processos eficientes de qualificação de leads e acompanhar métricas de desempenho.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias eficazes de prospecção para atingir as metas de crescimento da empresa;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de marketing, vendas e produto para alinhar esforços e otimizar a jornada do cliente;
  • Identificar oportunidades de mercado e áreas para expansão;
  • Gerenciar e liderar uma equipe de profissionais de prospecção, proporcionando orientação e suporte para garantir o desempenho máximo;
  • Garantir a formação continuada e desenvolvimento do time;
  • Promover um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e motivador;
  • Estabelecer e manter relacionamentos estratégicos com clientes potenciais, compreendendo suas necessidades e apresentando soluções personalizadas;
  • Realizar análises de mercado para entender as tendências, demandas e comportamentos dos clientes;
  • Utilizar dados e métricas para orientar decisões estratégicas;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com as equipes de marketing, vendas e desenvolvimento de produtos para garantir uma abordagem integrada e eficaz;
  • Ser responsável e protagonista na missão de alavancar o resultado final de vendas por meio do time de BDR.

Que Esperamos De Você

  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Administração ou área relacionada.
  • Domínio em liderança de pessoas e talentos;
  • Conhecimento profundo de estratégias de outbound marketing;
  • Experiência em prospecção, geração de demanda, growth, preferencialmente em empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com os segmentos de RH, ERP e demais sistemas de gestão;
  • Conhecimento de métricas e indicadores de marketing/vendas e geração de demanda;
  • Habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Disponibilidade para viagens.
  • Que Pode Potencializar Sua Candidatura
  • Pós-graduação ou MBA;
  • Conhecimento de máquina de vendas;
  • Experiência em liderança de times de geração de demandas e vendas para B2B;
  • Conhecimento em inbound marketing/sales;
  • Conhecimento de Exact Sales / Hubspot / Linkedin Sales Navigator / Ramper / Neoway;
  • Conhecimento de Spin selling, Bant e outras metodologias de venda consultiva;
  • Inglês e/ou Espanhol Fluente.

  • Seguro de Vida;

  • Cartão Wiipo com benefícios flexíveis;

  • TotalPass - Benefício de academias e bem-estar;
  • OnHappy - Benefício de vantagens para viagens;
  • Banco de horas;
  • Empresa cidadã: Licença maternidade e paternidade estendida;
  • Assistência natalidade;
  • Assistência PET;
  • Universidade Corporativa Senior;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento de carreira.

O Nosso Jeito Senior De Ser

Nossa cultura respeita as individualidades e potencializa as pessoas com inovação, colaboração e autonomia. Acreditamos na pluralidade, pois as experiências e perspectivas são únicas, com oportunidades que incluem diversidade de pessoas e de pensamentos. Porque é dessa forma que alcançamos grandes resultados, que geram o sucesso dos clientes, movidos pela dedicação de pessoas incríveis. Estas informações são específicas para esta oportunidade, mas você pode conferir todas as nossas vagas e ainda mais sobre como é ser Senior na nossa página de carreiras: senior.com.br/carreiras

Somos mais Senior!

Somos uma empresa brasileira reconhecida como uma das maiores desenvolvedoras de software para gestão do país. Com mais de 35 anos de história e atuação em todo o Brasil, impulsionamos a transformação digital de milhares de empresas por meio da tecnologia. Expandimos nossa presença para o mercado internacional com a aquisição de uma empresa na Colômbia, fortalecendo nossa atuação na América Latina. A qualidade das nossas soluções é resultado do trabalho de mais de 3.600 pessoas e de um portfólio completo voltado à alta performance. Guiados pelo propósito de Potencializar Pessoas e Impulsionar Negócios, conquistamos por oito vezes o reconhecimento como Great Place to Work®. Seguimos crescendo de forma consistente, valorizando pessoas, cultura e colaboração, porque impulsionar o futuro faz parte do nosso jeito de ser.

description:
Overview

Buscamos um profissional de Pré-Vendas com sólida experiência em sistemas de segurança eletrônica e controle de acesso, com atuação em projetos de médio porte. Será responsável por apoiar o time comercial na elaboração de soluções técnicas, dimensionamento de projetos, especificação de produtos e relacionamento com clientes e parceiros.

Requisitos

  • Requisitos necessários: Experiência sólida em sistemas de segurança eletrônica (principalmente CFTV IP, analógico, híbrido, NVRs, DVRs, VMS) e controle de acesso, atuando diretamente em pré-vendas, projetos ou implantação.
  • Vivência comprovada com as marcas: Hikvision, Dahua, Intelbras e Axis.
  • Experiência em projetos de médio porte, como:
    • Condomínios residenciais ou comerciais;
    • Indústrias de porte médio;
    • Edifícios corporativos, redes de lojas ou unidades distribuídas;
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de plantas arquitetônicas e diagramas de rede;
  • Conhecimentos em redes IP aplicadas a CFTV (endereçamento, VLAN, PoE, largura de banda, armazenamento);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de dimensionamento e softwares de projeto (preferencialmente dos próprios fabricantes ou similares);
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com facilidade em traduzir termos técnicos para linguagem de negócios;

Diferenciais (Desejáveis)

  • Certificações ou treinamentos específicos Hikvision, Dahua, Intelbras ou Axis.
  • Experiência com integrações de sistemas (controle de acesso + CFTV + alarme + analíticos);
  • Noções de segurança da informação aplicada a sistemas de vídeo em rede;
  • Experiência prévia em integradoras, distribuidores ou fabricantes de segurança eletrônica;
  • Vivência em elaboração de memoriais descritivos para licitações ou grandes contas.

Atividades

  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de vendas no entendimento das necessidades dos clientes em segurança eletrônica e controle de acesso;
  • Elaborar soluções técnicas com base em produtos e tecnologias das marcas Hikvision, Dahua, Intelbras e Axis;
  • Fazer o dimensionamento de sistemas de CFTV, controle de acesso, alarmes e, quando aplicável, integração com outros sistemas;
  • Desenvolver propostas técnicas e auxiliar na composição de propostas comerciais (memoriais descritivos, listas de materiais, diagramas em alto nível);
  • Realizar apresentações técnicas e demonstrações de soluções para clientes e integradores;
  • Apoiar o time em visitas técnicas (presenciais ou remotas) para levantamento de requisitos e validação de cenários;
  • Analisar editais, RFPs e especificações técnicas, garantindo aderência da solução;
  • Acompanhar o pós-venda técnico de projetos junto ao time de implantação, garantindo a aderência ao que foi proposto;
  • Manter-se atualizado quanto às linhas de produtos, releases de firmware, softwares VMS/NVR e novas tecnologias das marcas atendidas.

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries

NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, or luxury retail industries
  • Familiarity with Scrum/Agile practices, Jira, Confluence, and data catalog systems

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: USD-based pay with education, fitness, and team activity budgets.
  • Exciting projects: Modern solutions with Fortune 500 and top product companies.
  • Flextime: Flexible schedule with remote and office options.

It includes main stages: Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Interview with the Hiring Manager(s). Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit. If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics.

Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2 while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast.

Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence. The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symoolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact.

We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens.

You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us.

Check out our Culture page here

About The Role

We’re looking for an Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to our CEO, Felix, and key stakeholders. You will be the backbone of our executive operations, ensuring that leadership can focus on scaling InPlanet while you manage the complexity of their daily lives with agility, trust, and extreme discretion.

You’ll be the kind of person who is a natural problem-solver, highly organized, and comfortable connecting the dots in a fast-paced environment—always maintaining the highest standards of discretion while handling sensitive information and founder-level matters with absolute trust. You’ll act as a true partner, managing priorities and communication to ensure our founders stay effective and focused on our mission.

The Impact you can make

Your work will directly increase the effectiveness of our CEO and leadership team. By bringing clarity to communication, structure to priorities, and ownership to execution, you enable faster and better decision-making across the company.

You won’t just manage tasks: you will own outcomes , ensuring that priorities move forward and nothing falls through the cracks.

Core working relationships

  • Felix (CEO) – direct report and primary priority for support
  • Key stakeholders (CFO, COO, co-founder) – occasional support for meetings, travel, and specific demands
  • External Partners – coordinating with notaries, providers, and global contacts

Key Responsibilities

  • Structure and manage complex calendars and meetings, prioritizing urgencies and ensuring a smooth schedule
  • Manage executive inboxes, including reading, drafting answers, and prioritizing threads and forwards
  • Provide support for personal agenda and private administrative tasks as needed to optimize the CEO's time
  • Join meetings to collect insights, document action items, and provide clear summaries
  • Lead certain initiatives from start to finish, such as scheduling notary dates and ensuring document readiness
  • Conduct research on specific topics and prepare detailed reports to support business decision-making
  • Organize end-to-end travel arrangements for the CEO and support other founders (COO/CFO) when required
  • Track deadlines and follow up on action items independently, ensuring tasks are completed on time
  • Maintain the highest standards of confidentiality and discretion when handling sensitive information
  • Identify and lead improvements in administrative processes to make them more efficient and scalable

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

  • Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a high-level coordination role
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or a related field
  • Advanced English and Portuguese communication skills
  • Strong ability to manage multiple priorities and complex schedules
  • Experience handling executive communication and correspondence
  • High level of autonomy and decision-making in ambiguous environments
  • Based in the Campinas / São Paulo region with availability for hybrid work:
    -2 days/week with Felix in Valinhos
    -Travels to Piracicaba

Key Qualities

  • Highly organized and naturally enjoys structuring, prioritizing, and bringing clarity
  • Detail-oriented and outcome-focused: you don’t just start tasks, you finish them
  • Proactive and independent, with confidence to move forward without constant approvals
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Able to connect the dots quickly and understand business context
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling sensitive information
  • Driven, curious, and motivated to operate at a high level

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in fast-paced startups or international environments
  • Previous experience in climate tech, sustainability, or AgTech settings
  • Exposure to legal/financial processes (contracts, notaries, documentation)
  • Strong experience with research, synthesis, and executive-level reporting

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust: You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive: You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact: You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change
  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Home Office Budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40 days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate.

The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach.

These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Application Process

Roughly 6 hours across 3-6 weeks from CV-screening.

  • Interview with Talent & People Partner or Head of People (values & motivation)
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager (required core skills and competencies)

(optional third interview)

  • Challenge with 3+ team members (specific task, preparation needed)
  • Verbal reference check & psychometric profiling
  • Offer

How To Apply

  • We kindly ask you to submit your CV in English, as this is the main language we use here at InPlanet (unless it is justified to be in Portuguese).

It may apply to a range of working relationships, including full-time or part-time employment as well as independent contractor or service-based arrangements, depending on the candidate's location and compliance framework. Each engagement is carefully assessed on a case-by-case basis to ensure alignment with applicable laws and InPlanet’s global operating standards.

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. Objetivo da Posição: Será responsável por acelerar o crescimento das vendas nos marketplaces, utilizando Ads, campanhas e gestão ativa de anúncios como principal alavanca de crescimento, garantindo aumento de GMV com rentabilidade. Atuará como dono da performance do canal, sendo responsável por planejar, executar e otimizar investimentos em mídia e ações comerciais dentro dos marketplaces.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Growth e gestão de Ads (principal alavanca)
  • Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas de Ads dentro dos marketplaces.
  • Gerir e alocar orçamento de mídia com foco em ROAS e crescimento de GMV
  • Revisar continuamente campanhas em andamento
  • Otimizar ou descontinuar campanhas conforme performance
  • Identificar e escalar SKUs com maior potencial de crescimento via Ads
  • Gestão e otimização de anúncios
  • Revisar e otimizar anúncios com foco em aumento de conversão
  • Testar melhorias em títulos, imagens e conteúdo dos anúncios
  • Monitorar performance por SKU e atuar rapidamente em casos de queda de vendas
  • Campanhas e ações comerciais
  • Planejar e executar promoções e campanhas dentro dos marketplaces
  • Integrar campanhas com estratégias de Ads para maximizar resultado
  • Atuar de forma tática em oportunidades de curto prazo
  • Gestão de performance
  • Acompanhar indicadores de vendas, margem e eficiência das campanhas
  • Identificar desvios de performance e atuar rapidamente na correção
  • Apoiar decisões com base em dados (vendas, conversão, rentabilidade)
  • Integração com outras áreas
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com o time de pricing e supply chain
  • Sinalizar necessidades de ajuste de preço
  • Sinalizar necessidades de ajuste de estoque
  • Gestão de logística no marketplace (FULL)
  • Gerenciar a operação de estoque FULL
  • Definir quais SKUs irão operar no FULL
  • Monitorar performance dos SKUs no FULL vs modelo padrão

KPIS Da Posição

  • GMV dos marketplaces
  • ROAS
  • % Marketplaces sobre faturamento total da unidade de negócio
  • Margem líquida do canal
  • Taxa de conversão de anúncios
  • Resultado financeiro dos marketplaces

Hard Skills

  • Experiência comprovada com Mercado Livre
  • Experiência prática na gestão de Ads em marketplaces
  • Experiência com Shopee
  • Capacidade analítica
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas e aplicações de IA

Soft Skills

  • Forte orientação a resultado
  • Perfil analítico
  • Mão na massa
  • Senso de dono sobre o canal

About The Company

Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 170.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors. Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e atingimos ainda em 2025 o status de unicórnio. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu. Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa. Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.

  • Interest in mentorship or growing into a technical leadership role

Why join DoorDash Brazil?

  • Work on a global product, with real impact on millions of people
  • Be part of a fast‑growing engineering hub in São Paulo
  • Hybrid remote model with great office space in Av. Paulista
  • English immersion and opportunities to grow your international career
  • Contribute to a modern, scalable platform used across multiple countries
  • Build the future of local commerce with a team that values ownership, humility, and getting 1% better every day
  • Be part of a growing engineering organization committed to building inclusive teams and equitable opportunities

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

This position is open to candidates with disabilities. DoorDash welcomes applicants registered with the national autism registry (SisTEA) and others who seek an inclusive workplace.
If you need any accommodations, please inform your recruiting contact upon initial connection.

About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door‑to‑door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. Responsibilities

  • Develop, recommend, execute, and communicate cross‑functional procurement strategies and projects for assigned categories.
  • Lead and manage CAPEX procurement activities for Corbion units, ensuring delivery on time and within budget.
  • Collaborate proactively with internal stakeholders (Operations, Engineering Teams, Plant Managers, Finance, Project Managers, Legal, etc.) from the early stages of CAPEX projects.
  • Maintain updated contracts and commitments to ensure visibility of financial exposure. Identify, document, and implement cost‑reduction opportunities across the CAPEX supply chain.
  • Develop, recommend, and present annual budget values for CAPEX and/or Technical Goods & Services.
  • Represent the Procurement function and actively participate in cross‑functional Corbion projects.

  • Comply with all Quality and Food Safety requirements.

  • Solid understanding of CAPEX processes and Technical Goods & Services.

Corbion is a sustainable ingredients company dedicated to preserving what matters, including food and food production, health, and the planet. We specialize in lactic acid, lactic acid derivatives, food preservation solutions, functional blends, and algae ingredients, using our deep application and product knowledge to propel nature’s ingenuity through science. Leveraging our advanced capabilities in fermentation and preservation technology, we help customers differentiate their products in diverse markets ranging from food and animal nutrition to home & personal care, pharmaceuticals, electronics, medical devices, and bioplastics. É responsável pela usinagem de peças, preparando a máquina, realizando o balanceamento, alinhamento de contrapontas e posicionamento correto da mesma, verificando e registrando medidas, embalando e apontando a produção para garantir que atendam as especificações do cliente.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar a Manutenção Pelo Operador (MPO), utilizando check list e registrando as informações manualmente para assegurar que o equipamento esteja em plena condição de uso;
  • Preparar a máquina, verificando as ferramentas e informações para a usinagem utilizando as informações contidas na Ficha de Procedimento de Usinagem e o programa CNC para realizar o processo;
  • Realizar o balanceamento da peça na placa quando necessário, realizando avaliação do balanceamento de peças irregulares para regular o peso da peça na máquina;
  • Efetuar o alinhamento de contrapontas, utilizando o equipamento Relógio Comparador para assegurar que a peça não fique cônica;
  • Verificar a centragem e deslocamento da peça, observando se a peça está posicionada na máquina e corrigindo a posição se necessário para garantir o processo de usinagem;
  • Realizar a usinagem das peças, utilizando a OTF (Ordem Técnica de Fabricação), FTU (Ficha Técnica de Usinagem) e desenho da peça para assegurar a produção das peças dentro dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Verificar a medição da peça, utilizando equipamentos de medição para checar se não há falhas para garantir a medição final conforme o desenho;
  • Registrar as medidas durante e ao final do processo de usinagem, preenchendo o PID (Plano de Inspeção Dimensional) para assegurar que as medidas estejam dentro dos padrões estabelecidos;
  • Alojar a peça de acordo com sua característica, acondicionando em embalagem ou com materiais adequados para evitar danos nas peças;
  • Realizar apontamento de produção, registrando a informação no Sistema ERP para manter a rastreabilidade e formar banco de dados para indicadores de produção.

title: CRA - Future Roles (Brasil)
description:
Work Here Matters Everywhere

Why Syneos Health

  • We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
  • We are committed to our Total Self culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Our Total Self culture is what unites us globally, and we are dedicated to taking care of our people.
  • We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because when we bring together diversity of thoughts, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives – we’re able to create a place where everyone feels like they belong.

Job Responsibilities

  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiological Practices (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and with guidance develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • For the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical project data review and capture Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt, with the oversight of the Lead CRA, to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with project site personnel, or in collaboration with another CRA or Central Monitoring Associate (CMA). Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements.
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • For Real World Late Phase, the CRA I will use the business card title of Site Management Associate I. Additional responsibilities include: Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs Chart Abstraction activities and data collection Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

We are always excited to connect with great talent. This posting is intended for a (possible) upcoming opportunity rather than a live role. By expressing your interest, you'll be added to our talent pipeline and considered should this role become available.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.

Summary

Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA are responsible for overseeing and ensuring the integrity of clinical research studies by monitoring data and processes from a centralized location. This includes conducting remote monitoring of trial sites to verify compliance with regulatory requirements and clinical protocols. Utilizes data analytics and risk-based monitoring techniques to identify potential issues and trends, ensuring that trials are conducted in accordance with established clinical practices. Collaborates with site teams to develop and implement tools, procedures, and processes that enhance quality monitoring and support the overall success of clinical trials.

Under supervision assist in negotiations of budget and contract with site and via Site Contracts Service Centre and SAM lead with Sponsor until resolution of issues and contract execution. Assists with quality control and arranges execution of CTAs as well as archival of documents into repositories and capture of metadata.

title: Associate, Sales Operations
description:
About Eurasia Group and GZERO Media

Eurasia Group is the world's leading global research and advisory firm. We help clients understand, anticipate, and respond to instability and opportunities everywhere they do business. Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full‑fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.

Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasília, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on‑the‑ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world. We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Position Overview

Eurasia Group is seeking a high‑performing sales operations associate in São Paulo. This entry‑level sales operations support role includes a wide range of responsibilities, with an emphasis on proactive collaboration, strong communication, and organizational skills to complete tasks for a wide range of activities supporting our sales activities. In return, the hire will be a part of a dynamic sales operations team, working closely with business development staff and analysts, at the world’s market‑leading political risk advisory firm in an increasingly critical market space.

The sales operations associate will spend a majority of their time supporting our operations, business development, and analyst teams, reporting to the associate director, with a heavy focus on end‑to‑end management of conference call logistics and comprehensive administrative and operational support for the sales teams. This includes key responsibilities in account management (with a focus on CRM management and reporting), and responding to time‑sensitive, ad‑hoc sales requests as they arise. We are looking for someone with appropriate project management experience and a positive can‑do attitude. Given the varying nature of our business development needs and operations change management at the firm, you will need to be a quick learner, a versatile problem solver, and thrive in an entrepreneurial environment.

Responsibilities

  • Manage conference call logistics, including generation of client registration and attendance reports, call log maintenance, liaising with speakers to ensure a smooth presentation experience, troubleshooting technical issues, updating the conference call user manual, and providing training to research teams.
  • Support account management efforts across various client services teams including client interaction reporting, contact and account entitlement management in Salesforce, and other recurring account management activities.
  • Respond to client inquiries promptly and professionally, ensuring a positive customer experience.
  • Utilize Eurasia Group’s cloud‑based business intelligence platform to produce regular reports and ad‑hoc analysis of research production and consumption, and analyze readership trends in various segments of the client base.
  • Report regularly on interactions with specific clients to ensure compliance with research‑related regulations.
  • Direct website inquiries to the appropriate client services teams.
  • Approve requests for access to Eurasia Group content on various research aggregation platforms.
  • Ad hoc projects as required.

Required Skills

  • Strong English oral and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, problem solving, teamwork skills, confidentiality, discretion, reliability, and judgment; positive can‑do attitude; someone who will “own” the role.
  • Agility and flexibility in response to changing priorities and needs.
  • Fluency with MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Zoom, and Salesforce.com CRM system and ability to pick up and learn new technologies as needed.
  • Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to meet deadlines.

Additional Requirements

  • Undergraduate/first‑level degree (e.g., bachelor’s degree) desired with coursework in business administration or related field.
  • 1‑2+ years’ experience in a professional services environment, especially a corporate sales, operations, or events function.
  • Experience interfacing with multinational corporations.
  • A strong interest in international affairs and politics, including an understanding of Eurasia Group’s core services.

At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put politics first for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Our leadership team is dedicated to embedding this approach into everything we do and how we lead because we care deeply about our work and our people.

title: Commercial Strategy Specialist
description:
AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI Growth Group

ABI’s Growth Division is the center of innovation and tech development within ABI, which is driving ABI’s growth by developing innovations for the core beer business and creating new hyper‑growth tech businesses. ABI Growth includes the following business lines: BEES (our business‑to‑business e‑commerce and SaaS business, also focused on new technologies), TaDa and Ze Delivery (our direct‑to‑consumer e‑commerce businesses), and several other high‑tech divisions, including fintech and venture capital.

This role will be largely dedicated to BEES, which is on a mission to transform ABI’s business‑to‑business sales model by putting customers and data at its heart. Whether you are a small to medium sized retailer or a supplying partner, BEES provides you with the tools, data, and insights you need to help your business thrive. Today, more than 2.5 million retailers across 19 countries use BEES every month to browse for products, place orders, earn rewards, arrange deliveries, manage invoices, and access business insights all from one place.

Learn more on how BEES keeps business buzzing at

About the Role

The Commercial Strategy Specialist is responsible for maximizing profitable growth across BEES Link 3P through strong governance, analytical rigor, and scalable operating standards. Aligned with our mission — to maximize profitable growth by institutionalizing pricing compliance, P&L governance, disciplined product prioritization, and scalable operating processes — this role plays a critical part in strengthening the structural foundations of our commercial model.

This position sits at the intersection of Commercial, Product, Finance, and Operations. The Commercial Strategy Specialist transforms complex business problems into data‑driven insights and scalable frameworks that protect margins, improve investment allocation, and accelerate disciplined decision‑making. This is a high‑impact role designed for a senior professional who combines strategic thinking with hands‑on analytical execution.

What you'll do

  • Own P&L governance for BEES Link 3P, consolidating partner‑level performance data and translating it into clear visibility on margin health, revenue quality, and profitability trends.
  • Provide broad‑ranging legal advice to other teams across ABI Growth, including relating to SaaS and licensing transactions, strategic commercial relationships, data monetization strategies, data privacy projects, and product counseling.
  • Build and maintain scalable operating frameworks — standard templates, decision criteria, governance protocols — that reduce dependency on ad hoc judgement and improve process consistency.
  • Drive product prioritization rigor by developing structured intake processes, effort‑impact scoring models, and backlog governance routines that align roadmap decisions with commercial outcomes.
  • Design and maintain investment evaluation frameworks that assess initiatives against a shared value logic, distinguishing between cost avoidance, governance improvement, and incremental revenue generation.
  • Develop and update reference models for take rate and GMV impact analysis, enabling leadership to make pricing and product decisions grounded in real partner data.
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies across the OTC and GTM cycle, and lead initiatives to eliminate waste and improve execution speed without compromising governance standards.
  • Synthesize cross‑functional inputs — from Commercial, Finance, Product, and Operations — into integrated business reviews that surface risks early and enable proactive course correction.
  • Support JBP structuring and partner onboarding processes by providing analytical and governance scaffolding that ensures new engagements are commercially sound from the outset.

What you'll need

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field; advanced degree (MBA, MSc) is a strong differentiator.
  • Experience in a business analytics, commercial operations, strategy, or financial governance role, ideally within a technology, marketplace, or CPG environment.
  • Proven ability to build and operationalize governance frameworks, pricing models, or P&L management tools in complex, multi‑stakeholder environments.
  • Strong analytical proficiency — advanced Excel/Google Sheets, SQL, or Python/R — with the ability to work directly with large datasets and translate findings into executive‑level insights.
  • Demonstrated experience with take rate modelling, GMV analysis, or margin management in a platform or marketplace business is a significant plus.
  • Desire to help build the legal function and data privacy program from the ground up.
  • Effective communicator who can synthesize complex analytical work into clear business narratives for senior leadership and cross‑functional partners.
  • Practical legal approach, focused on enabling the business strategy rather than a compliance‑first mindset.
  • Fully fluent in English and Portuguese; proficiency in Spanish is a plus.

Its solutions are used in highly demanding environments where reliability is critical, such as aerospace, defense, space, and selected oil & gas applications. As part of this strategy, the group is seeking to rebuild and sustainably structure its presence in Brazil. To support this ambition, the company is looking for a Senior Business Developer / Sales Engineer to lead market development and act as the key local technical reference. The position is based in the State of São Paulo, ideally in São Paulo or São José dos Campos, with regular travel to client sites.

Missions

  • Reporting to international management and working closely with the European and U.S. headquarters, you will be responsible for developing and structuring the Brazilian market. You will act as the local relay between Brazil and France, ensuring alignment on commercial strategy, technical requirements, and cultural expectations.
  • You will lead business development activities, identifying new opportunities in aerospace, defense, space, and selected oil & gas segments. You will create and manage a local client portfolio, with a strong focus on long-term, high-value relationships.
  • You will manage the entire sales cycle, from prospecting and early technical discussions through to contract negotiation and project follow-up, in coordination with engineering and production teams.
  • You will act as a technical-commercial interlocutor for clients, understanding their operational constraints and providing first-level technical support upstream in project phases.
  • You will represent the company during customer meetings, site visits, and industry events, contributing to the visibility and credibility of the group in the Brazilian aerospace and defense ecosystem.
  • Beyond pure sales activities, you will contribute to structuring the local presence, building a robust pipeline, and laying the foundations for sustainable growth in Brazil.

Profile

  • You hold a degree in engineering (mechanical, electrical/electronic, electromechanical, mechatronics, aerospace, or related fields) and have a solid background in technical and industrial environments. MBA and/or relevant experience in the aerospace industry is strongly recommended.
  • You have significant experience in B2B technical sales or business development, ideally within aerospace, defense, or other high-technology industrial sectors. Exposure to harsh-environment applications is a strong advantage.
  • You demonstrate a balanced profile (technical and commercial), with the ability to engage in complex technical discussions while driving business development and negotiations.
  • You are autonomous, reliable, and results-oriented, with a strong entrepreneurial mindset. You are comfortable operating in an environment with limited day-to-day supervision and clear expectations on outcomes.
  • You bring energy, ambition, and a genuine desire to build and grow a market. Profiles primarily seeking comfort or end-of-career stability are not targeted.
  • You have strong interpersonal skills and the ability to bridge cultures, particularly between Brazilian and European (French) business environments.
  • You speak Portuguese fluently and have a professional working level of English. Knowledge of French is strongly recommended.
  • You are based in the State of São Paulo or willing to relocate, and available for regular travel within Brazil.

Why join our client ?

Our client is an agile, technology-driven industrial group offering customized solutions and strong technical support. Brazil represents a strategic market for the group, and this role offers the opportunity to play a key part in shaping the local presence.

You will join a company that values trust, autonomy, and responsibility, and you will have the opportunity to take real ownership of market development while working closely with international teams.

If you are motivated by complex technical environments, long-term customer relationships, and the challenge of building a market, this position offers a unique career opportunity.

title: Senior/Staff Product Designer
description:
Overview

The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 220 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
  • Earned 145k+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
  • Been ranked as one of Europe’s most promising privately held SaaS startups (4th in Sifted’s 2025 B2B SaaS Rising 100)
  • Raised $240m to date, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our recent $180m Series C - bringing us to a $2.5bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Role

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.

We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

  • Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.
  • AI: This team is perfect for designers who’ve worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.
  • Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.
  • Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

Our team structure evolves quickly and these team assignments may shift in the coming weeks.

Regardless of the team your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n’s user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

Responsibilities

  • End-to-end product design: Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.
  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.
  • Work effectively on complex features with a strong engineering mindset and understanding of the underlying technology.
  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.
  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.
  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.
  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.
  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.
  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • Product design excellence: You’re proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.
  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.
  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.
  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.
  • Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.
  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.
  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.
  • Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

Nice-to-haves

  • Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.
  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.
  • Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.
  • Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.
  • Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.
  • Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.
  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n

Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation – We offer fair and attractive pay.
  • Ownership – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.
  • Work/life balance – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:
  • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.
  • Future planning – Europe: pension contributions according to local country norms.*
  • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.
  • Financial security – Europe: local country norm benefits.*
  • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.
  • Career growth – You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.
  • A passionate team – Regular hackathons to showcase what you build.
  • Remote-first – Remote across Europe, with off-sites; some roles like US sales may be hybrid.
  • Giving back – We provide $100 per month to support projects you care about.
  • AI enablement – Everyone gets an unlimited AI budget to explore and use tools to boost productivity.
  • Transparency – We share what everyone’s working on and the company’s status.
  • An ambitious but kind culture – eNPS 94 in 2024.

title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description:
About Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing.

Technology Focus

This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure.

Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical:

  • RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability.
  • Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community.
  • LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI.
  • Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling.
  • OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments.

These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management.

Location

We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone.

What You Will Focus On

  • Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach.
  • Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise.
  • Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth.
  • Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product.
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team.
  • Write high‑quality code to create new features.
  • Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them.
  • Review code produced by other engineers.
  • Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions.

What We Are Looking For in You

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path.
  • Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations.
  • Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology.
  • Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system.
  • Professional written and spoken English.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments.
  • Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Performance engineering and security experience.

What We Offer You

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Job Description

At Boeing, we innovate and collaborate to make the world a better place. We’re committed to fostering an environment for every teammate that’s welcoming, respectful and inclusive, with great opportunity for professional growth. Find your future with us.

Boeing Brazil is seeking Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer , reporting to the Safety Manager, working out of the São José Dos Campos office.

The Senior Aerospace Systems Safety Engineer will be responsible for working cross functionally to ensure airplane level safety analyses are appropriately conducted. Understanding the complex integration of airplane systems, human factors, and airplane integration into the operational environment are required in this role. The Airplane Safety deliverables directly feed airplane compliance and require an extreme attention to detail as well as a healthy engineering curiosity.

Our team works hard to build relationships with our customers across all of engineering and the programs. To do this we must be technically savvy, great communicators, and have a passion to learn more. We are involved in every aspect of designing and certifying our products and must maintain an unrelenting focus on compliance, safety, and product integrity without compromise.

If you’re ready for a challenging new role that is critical to the success of our programs then this might be the job for you. Successful candidates will be reliable, trustworthy, and accountable for delivering results. Familiarity with ARP-4754, ARP-4761, safety analysis, and hazard assessments will greatly benefit you in this role.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Provide safety design and analysis expertise to program stakeholders and leadership
  • Validate and verify airplane level safety requirements
  • Develop certification strategies for systems and airplane level safety issues
  • Execute airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotorburst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)
  • Ensure adequate redundancy and physical separation of critical systems
  • Lead airplane level safety analyses like Runway Excursion or Airplane Common Mode to ensure integration across multiple functional systems
  • Design and update safety processes according to the last industry standards, regulations, best practices, and lessons

Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience)

  • Must have existing rights to work in Brazil.
  • Must have a bachelor’s degree in engineering.
  • Must be registered or eligible to register with the Engineering and Agronomy Regional Council (Conselho Regional de Engenharia e Agronomia - CREA).
  • Proficient in both verbal and written communications skills in the English Language
  • In depth experience with safety requirements, system safety analysis such as Risk Assessments, Functional Hazard Assessments (FHA), Fault-tree Analysis (FTA), Systems Safety Assessment, and system design or integration.

Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)

  • Familiarity with FAR Part , and industry practices like ARP 4761 & 4754
  • Familiarity working with FAA
  • Experience with certification plan
  • Experience with airplane level threat analyses (bird strike, rotor burst, cargo fire, tire and wheel failures, etc.)

Relocation

This position offers relocation based on candidate eligibility.

Additional Information

This requisition is for a locally hired position in Brazil. Candidates must have current legal authorization to live and work in Brazil. Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing U.S. based payroll. Please also submit a CV or resume written in English.

Applications for this position will be accepted through April 15th, 2026.

  • É operacional: acompanha de perto, não só pelo dashboard

  • Tem experiência com CRM e cultura de registro no time
  • Vem de comercial B2B com perfil de cliente exigente — e quer aplicar essa visão num B2C em crescimento acelerado
  • Tem curiosidade natural por produto de design, lifestyle ou alto padrão.

Remuneração

Variável atrelado ao resultado do time — conversão, ticket médio e atingimento de meta coletiva

Presencial em São Paulo | Seg–Sex

Acreditamos que o líder precisa ganhar quando o time ganha. Vamos alinhar os números na conversa, com transparência.

Somos uma empresa jovem, em crescimento acelerado, com tudo ainda sendo construído. Isso significa autonomia real, impacto direto e muito espaço para quem quer deixar marca — mas também significa que você vai precisar montar estrutura onde ainda não existe.

Se você precisa de tudo pronto para trabalhar, esse não é o lugar certo. Se você gosta de construir, vai se sentir em casa.

Se faz sentido pra você, faz sentido pra gente conversar.

title: GTM Enterprise - Founding Team
description:
The Role

We're looking for an Enterprise Sales to open doors, close strategic deals, and build lasting relationships with large enterprises across Brazil and Latin America.

You won't be selling a commodity. You'll be selling a new product that outperforms established players. You'll need the conviction to pitch it accordingly.

This is a role for someone who can walk into a room of senior executives, translate complex AI into a simple business impact story. And leave with a signed contract.

You’ll own the full sales cycle: from identifying and qualifying accounts, through navigating complex procurement processes, to handing off a live client to our Forward Deployment team. Along the way, you’ll shape how the market perceives Avra. We know that every interaction is a chance to build our reputation as a tier-1 technology company.

Please note - we are not building an LLM, we are not agentic AI, we are not generative. You will sell a predictive AI platform that models data to predict how an SMB will behave: will that SMB pay back their loan? Is that SMB worth targeting with an online ad? Will that SMB be receptive to a cross-sell?

What You’ll Do

Hunt and close enterprise accounts. Prospect, qualify, and develop new opportunities with large strategic accounts: financial institutions, marketplaces, distributors. Any enterprise with significant B2B operations. You own the pipeline from first touch to signed contract.

Own the pre-sales narrative. Develop compelling, tailored presentations for every audience: from data teams who want to see model performance, to C-level executives who need to understand business impact. You’ll translate our AI platform into a clear and persuasive story.

Drive adoption through handover. You don't disappear after the signature. You’ll guide the client through early implementation, working hand-in-hand with our Forward Deployment team to ensure a smooth transition and fast time-to-value.

Sell with conviction and data. You take a data-driven approach. You know the time to sale and time to production for each of your deals. You use numbers to qualify opportunities, structure proposals, and negotiate pricing that reflects the value Avra delivers.

Be the voice of the market internally. Share customer learnings, competitive intelligence, and market signals with product, engineering, and leadership. Your insights from the field will directly influence product roadmap and company strategy.

What You’ll Bring

Proven enterprise sales track record. 4+ years in B2B sales, consistently meeting or exceeding targets. You've sold into large, complex organizations and know how to navigate multi-stakeholder procurement cycles with minimal hand-holding.

Experience selling new products. At least 2 years selling something that was either new to your organization or new to the market. You know what it takes to create a category, educate buyers, and close when there's no established playbook.

Startup DNA. You've worked in a hyper-growth tech environment before. You thrive in ambiguity. You build your own processes, move fast, and don't wait for permission.

Executive presence. You're comfortable in a room with C-level stakeholders. You communicate with clarity and confidence, negotiate with backbone, know when to push and when to listen.

Strategic deal structuring. You think creatively about how to structure deals… Bundling use cases? Sure. Landing in one department to expand across the organization? Check. Designing partnerships that create long-term value for both sides? Win-win.

Curiosity and a growth mindset. You're genuinely interested in how businesses work, where they struggle, and how technology can change the game. You ask sharp questions and are never satisfied with surface-level answers.

Comfort with technical products. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you need to hold your own in conversations about AI models, data infrastructure, and analytical workflows. You bridge the gap between what our engineers build and what the market needs to hear.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling to financial institutions, fintechs, or large B2B platforms
  • Background in credit, risk, marketing/growth or data analytics
  • Consulting or product management experience that sharpened your strategic thinking

Why Avra

  • You’ll sell a product that demonstrably outperforms the competition - the technology is already in production with real world results
  • You’ll help define how a category-defining company goes to market
  • You’ll be part of a small, high-caliber team where your work has immediate, visible impact
  • Competitive compensation with meaningful upside tied to performance

description:
Job Title: Marketing Lead (HubSpot- RevOps)

Location: Hybrid (Batel, Curitiba, 3 days in-office – 2 days remote)

Reports To: CEO

About RevBlack

RevBlack is a rapidly growing Revenue Operations consultancy. We help companies solve hard problems, optimize their revenue engines, and scale. We don't do "bare minimum" work; we are dedicated to building outstanding things. We are looking for a long-term partner (5+ years) to join our team, own the marketing function entirely, and drive our next phase of growth.

The Role

RevBlack is seeking a Marketing Lead (HubSpot- RevOps) to drive our revenue-generation ecosystem. This is a high-stakes "Player-Coach" role designed for a professional who seamlessly bridges the gap between visionary strategy and technical CRM execution. You will take charge of a specialized three-person squad (Content, Design, and Ops) that possesses high potential and is ready to reach elite performance levels under a culture of radical ownership.

This is not a position for an "overseer" who stays in the shadows of delegation. You must be eager to own our technological stack, master our data architecture, and execute the growth roadmap. Your primary objective is to accelerate our pipeline through surgical engagement with Private Equity partners and the delivery of premium-tier content.

Your Core Responsibilities

1. Leadership & Accountability (The "Coach")

  • Team Orchestration: Supervise the daily production of our creative and administrative talent. Your mission is to professionalize their output and elevate their standards through active development and clear performance benchmarks.
  • Commitment to Craftsmanship: We have zero tolerance for "average." You will audit every campaign and piece of copy to ensure it aligns with our high-end standards of excellence. AI should be leveraged for scale, but it must never replace human market intelligence or creative depth.
  • Full Functional Accountability: You are the ultimate authority on marketing outcomes. If a project stalls or a workflow breaks, you don’t shift blame. You lead the correction, the post-mortem analysis, and the strategy to ensure it doesn't happen again.

2. Marketing Operations & Strategy (The "Player")

  • Systems & CRM Architecture: Deep, hands-on mastery of HubSpot is mandatory. You will be responsible for auditing automations, architecting transparent reporting, and ensuring our CRM data is clean, actionable, and scalable.
  • Precision Pipeline Growth: We avoid mass-blast noise. You will design and execute sophisticated, high-touch campaigns aimed specifically at Private Equity operating partners and B2B leadership.
  • High-End Referral Ecosystems: Develop and manage a structured referral engine that maintains a personal, premium feel while being engineered for high-volume scale.
  • Analytics-Based Strategy: You will rely on historical data to identify winning strategies rather than guesswork. You will establish clear KPIs and take 100% responsibility for hitting them.

3. Operational Discipline (EOS)

RevBlack is powered by the Entrepreneurial Operating System (EOS) . In this role, you will be the driving force behind our marketing rhythm. This includes architecting quarterly "Rocks," facilitating high-impact L10 meetings, and maintaining the integrity of the marketing scorecard. While prior EOS exposure is a major asset, a relentless commitment to mastering this framework is mandatory for success.

The Ideal Candidate

  • Veteran B2B Leader: You possess a proven track record of managing talent and scaling revenue within a consultancy or professional services environment.
  • MarTech Specialist: Deep, hands‑on expertise in HubSpot (Marketing Ops) is non‑negotiable. We also value familiarity with Webflow and a strategic approach to SEO.
  • Pipeline Architect: You are obsessed with results, not just "vanity metrics." You know how to build a sales pipeline that is both measurable and predictable.
  • Radical Candor: You thrive in an environment of high standards. You provide feedback that is direct, productive, and aligned with The RevBlack Diamond Rule .
  • Strategic Owner: You don’t wait for a roadmap; you build it. You bring the CEO solutions and fresh perspectives, viewing every obstacle as a catalyst for growth.

Our Core Values

We hire, fire, review, and reward based on these values.

  • 100% Responsibility: We own our choices and outcomes. We don’t make excuses, blame others, or hide mistakes.
  • The Obstacle is the Way: We don't just endure challenges; we get curious about them. We turn negatives into positives and use obstacles to improve our condition.
  • Set and Meet Expectations: We build trust by being clear about what we will do and when. If we say it will be done, it gets done.
  • Craftsmanship: We take pride in doing great work. We are meticulous, patient, and detail-oriented—like a watchmaker ensuring every piece is perfect.
  • The RevBlack Diamond Rule: We cultivate high emotional intelligence. We ensure that every client and team member feels better, more secure, and more understood after interacting with us

Why Join RevBlack?

  • Impact: You will work directly with the CEO and shape the future of the company.
  • Growth: We are growing year-over-year with big goals for 2026 and beyond.
  • Culture: A high-performance team that solves hard problems together, supports one another, and dislikes office politics.
